# spec-plan.json

The JSON Schema in [schemas/spec-plan.json](https://github.com/amritk/vector/blob/main/schemas/spec-plan.json), as a reference.

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `programName` | `string` | yes | matches `^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$`. |
| `axioms` | [object[]](#root-axioms) | yes | The formal contract extracted from the casual prompt. at least 1 items. |
| `units` | [object[]](#root-units) | yes | Dijkstra-style layered decomposition, lowest layer first. Keep it small: 1-4 pure functions, each layer only calls strictly lower layers. at least 1 items; at most 4 items. |

No other property is allowed.

<a id="root-axioms"></a>

### `axioms[]`

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | yes | Short stable id, e.g. "AX1" or "AX-RATE" (letters, digits, _ and - only — ids are embedded in emitted source). matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$`. |
| `kind` | `"pre"` \| `"post"` | yes | pre = a constraint on inputs (including "throws if X" → precondition NOT X); post = a guarantee about the result. |
| `statement` | `string` | yes | Precise mathematical English, e.g. "for all amount &gt;= 0, result equals amount times 0.91". |

No other property is allowed.

<a id="root-units"></a>

### `units[]`

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` | yes | matches `^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$`. |
| `layer` | `integer` | yes | at least 1. |
| `purpose` | `string` | yes |  |
| `params` | [object[]](#root-units-params) | yes |  |
| `returnType` | `"Real"` \| `"Int"` \| `"Bool"` | yes |  |
| `relevantAxiomIds` | `string`[] | yes | Which axioms this unit is responsible for enforcing. |

No other property is allowed.

<a id="root-units-params"></a>

#### `units[].params[]`

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` | yes | matches `^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$`. |
| `type` | `"Real"` \| `"Int"` \| `"Bool"` | yes |  |
